summary: All three acceptance criteria for ISS-0808 independently verified from source. 20/20 tests pass. No dead-default-argument warnings. No code path divergence found.

ac1.criterion: lib/letflow/plugs/tenant_status.ex derives PLATFORM_ADMIN via Letflow.Api.Authorization.roles_from_strings/1, so exactly one code path maps role strings to the PLATFORM_ADMIN role

evidence.platform_admin_atom: Line 66: `@platform_admin :PLATFORM_ADMIN` — atom, not string; confirmed by reading file directly
evidence.normalization_call: Line 99: `roles = Authorization.roles_from_strings(raw_roles)` — called before the cond on line 101
evidence.cond_guard: Line 101: `tenant.status == :inactive and @platform_admin not in roles` — uses the atom-typed `roles` list returned by roles_from_strings/1
evidence.no_other_paths: Grep of lib/ confirms the only occurrence of `roles_from_strings` in tenant_status.ex is at line 99; no raw string comparison `"PLATFORM_ADMIN" in` exists anywhere in the file; no other code path to the exemption
evidence.grep_evidence: rg 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' lib/letflow/plugs/tenant_status.ex returns only the @platform_admin module attribute definition and the ISS-0808 comment — no string literal comparison

ac2.criterion: The tenant-inactive-403 exemption behavior for PLATFORM_ADMIN is unchanged, proven by a test exercising both an exempt PLATFORM_ADMIN and a non-exempt actor against an inactive tenant

evidence.describe_block: test/letflow/plugs/tenant_status_test.exs: describe block `"ISS-0808 — PLATFORM_ADMIN check uses Authorization.roles_from_strings/1"` present
evidence.exempt_platform_admin_test: Test `"a PLATFORM_ADMIN caller (string role) is exempt via roles_from_strings normalization"`: calls `call_plug(:get, tenant.id, ["PLATFORM_ADMIN"])` against an `:inactive` tenant, asserts `refute conn.halted` and `conn.status == nil`
evidence.non_exempt_actor_test: Test `"a non-PLATFORM_ADMIN caller is not exempt, even with valid roles"`: calls `call_plug(:get, tenant.id, ["PROCESS_OPERATOR"])` against an `:inactive` tenant, asserts `conn.halted` and `conn.status == 403`
evidence.also_present: Additional non-exempt coverage: test `"an unknown role string is not exempt (roles_from_strings/1 filters out unknown strings)"` uses `["PLATFORM_ADMIN_WANNABE"]` → 403
evidence.test_run_output: mix test test/letflow/plugs/tenant_status_test.exs -- Result: 20 passed (exit code 0, 0.3 seconds, async: true)
evidence.warnings_as_errors_run: mix test test/letflow/plugs/tenant_status_test.exs --warnings-as-errors -- Result: 20 passed (exit code 0, no warnings)

ac3.criterion: A regression test would fail if the plug reverted to the raw string comparison

evidence.test_name: "a PLATFORM_ADMIN caller (string role) is exempt via roles_from_strings normalization"
evidence.regression_mechanism: @platform_admin is the atom :PLATFORM_ADMIN (confirmed at tenant_status.ex line 66). auth_context.roles carries strings (e.g. ["PLATFORM_ADMIN"]). If roles_from_strings/1 were removed and the raw string list were compared against the atom: `:PLATFORM_ADMIN not in ["PLATFORM_ADMIN"]` evaluates to `true` (atom ≠ string in Elixir's `in` operator), so the cond guard `tenant.status == :inactive and @platform_admin not in roles` fires → reject_inactive/1 called → conn halted with 403 → `refute conn.halted` assertion fails → test fails
evidence.type_mismatch_proof: Elixir's `in` operator uses strict equality (===). :PLATFORM_ADMIN (atom) !== "PLATFORM_ADMIN" (binary). The atom is never found in a [String.t()] list, making the exemption permanently unreachable if roles_from_strings/1 is removed while @platform_admin stays an atom
evidence.unknown_role_filter_also_guarded: Test `"an unknown role string is not exempt"` further guards that roles_from_strings/1's filter-unknown-strings behavior is exercised: ["PLATFORM_ADMIN_WANNABE"] → roles_from_strings returns [] → no atom match → 403 asserted

iss_0069_check.detail: mix letflow.check.test cannot complete on this Windows host: WSL bash finds `mix` at /mnt/c/Program Files/Elixir/bin/elixir but cannot find `erl` (Erlang VM is a native Windows install not on WSL's PATH). Root cause: scripts/test_parallel.sh has CRLF line endings (git core.autocrlf=true; *.sh not covered by .gitattributes eol=lf). This is a pre-existing environment incompatibility unrelated to ISS-0808.

manual_verification.defp_with_default: unique_slug(prefix \\ "tenant") — the sole defp with a default argument
manual_verification.call_sites: All call sites in the file use unique_slug() (no-arg form), which exercises the default value — the default is NOT dead
manual_verification.dead_default_pattern: Elixir's 'default values for the optional arguments' warning fires when the shorter-arity form is NEVER called (always called with explicit value). Here the shorter-arity form unique_slug/0 is the only call pattern, so the default IS used — no warning emitted
manual_verification.warnings_as_errors_confirmation: mix test test/letflow/plugs/tenant_status_test.exs --warnings-as-errors exited 0 with zero compiler warnings — independently confirms no ISS-0069 class warning exists in this file
manual_verification.compile_check: mix compile --warnings-as-errors exited 0 with no output — zero warnings in production code either
